description: A snapshot of out-of-stock and low-stock products and variants.
label: Inventory report

dashboard_url.label: Dashboard address
dashboard_url.description: Where this type of report is listed in the dashboard, for the link in its email. The email adds the report's id.

low_stock_count.label: Low stock
low_stock_count.description: At or below the threshold but above zero.

attention_pct.label: Needing attention %
attention_pct.description: Share of tracked SKUs that are low or out.

items.label: Items
items.description: Low and out-of-stock SKUs, out of stock first, then soonest to run out.

days_of_cover.label: Days of cover
days_of_cover.description: Days the stock lasts at the 30-day rate; empty when nothing sold.

items_hidden.label: Not listed
items_hidden.description: Low or out-of-stock SKUs beyond the list limit.

truncated.label: Partial
truncated.description: Set when a read hit its page ceiling, so counts are a lower bound.

summary.label: Summary
summary.description: Display only: the dashboard draws the headline figures here from the report's other fields. Never stored.

types.description: A new inventory snapshot was generated.
